skill.summary: Control FreeCAD via MCP to create and modify 3D models, automate CAD tasks, solve constraints, and integrate part libraries programmatically.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of FreeCAD MCP Skill.

- Enables AI agents to control FreeCAD using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Supports automated creation of 3D models, part generation from descriptions, and constraint solving
- Integrates with LangChain and Google ADK agents
- Includes instructions for installing the FreeCAD addon and starting the RPC server
- Provides example prompts and agent configurations for rapid setup
